title: Burst after the largest recent two-hour jump, trend-aligned

source.title: MAX momentum in cryptocurrency markets, via lab hypothesis H-024

rule_summary: Two-hour blocks from finished hourly bars (even UTC hours), orders at the next hourly open. Let J be the biggest single-block percent gain among the last 30 blocks. The regime is on when J is at least the median of the 150 preceding J values. Buy at a block close when the regime is on, the close is above the 50-block mean and above the highest close of the previous 10 blocks, nothing open, three blocks passed since the last sale. Sell when a block closes under the 20-block mean. Stop two percent under the fill. Buys only in blocks opening 00:00 to 16:00 UTC; flat by the 23:00 UTC open or after twelve hours.
mechanism: Lottery-seeking buyers chase assets that just printed an extreme gain, so a fresh high after a jump regime keeps attracting flow for some hours. Parent windows kept, block length reduced from a day to two hours. Expected gross move about 0.8% on winners; a design estimate.
